This reason seems unusual and potentially problematic, as it implies that the person prioritized personal entertainment over their work commitments. My initial reaction is that this behavior seems unacceptable. Calling in sick to work is typically reserved for situations where an employee is genuinely unwell or unable to perform their duties due to health reasons. Using this excuse to attend a movie feels like a misuse of the system and a lack of respect for the employer and colleagues who may have to cover the absent employee's responsibilities. I can understand that everyone needs a break and some time to relax, but using a fake sick day to attend a movie doesn't seem like an honest or responsible way to take that break.
